title: Re - The Arrest By The Japanese Consular Police Of Two Swiss Subjects

page_data.en:
Copy for S.B. (Special Branch)
411
4 10 40

"C"
Misc.549/40.
Hongkew
October 1st. 40.

1.

Re the arrest by the Japanese Consular Police
of two Swiss subjects.

At 12.28 a.m. on 1/10/40, a telephone communication
was received from an unknown male who reported that
fighting was in progress at the intersection of Broadway-
Yuenchang Road, and requested that police be sent to
the scene.

R.P.S.s 667 Inoue and 861 Yamaguchi, attended
and returned to the station to report that the fight
had taken place between a Swiss and a Korean both of
whom had been taken by the Japanese Consular Police to their
Sub-Office, No.213 Yangtszepoo Road.

The undersigned accompanied by D.P.S.763 Izumi,
proceeded to the above sub-office where two Swiss sub-
jects namely Georges Emile Guhl, age 35, Restaurant
owner, residing No.1473 Hu Yuan Road and Otto Benkert,
age 27, residing No.58 Yuenchang Road, together with a
Korean named M. Oka, age 40, Merchant, residing No.25
Yuenchang Road, were found under detention.

The two Swiss subjects were questioned by the
undersigned when Guhl, stated that he and his friend
Benkert, had prior to the trouble visited the Leaf Bar
No.1 Yuenchang Road, and at about 12.10 a.m. he came

To D.D.O. "C".
Sir,
Otto Benkert
was interviewed
about 9.45 a.m. on
1/10/40 by D.S.I.
Beloshenko at his
home and he stated
both had been released
about 4.15 a.m. on
1/10/40 by the J.C.
Police. He also
stated they do not
intend to take the
matter up with the
Swiss Consul.

Y.O.S.
Sgd.A.Telfer.
Sen.Det.i/c.
1/10/40.

“C”
杂项 549/40。
虹口
1940年10月1日。

1.

关于日本领事警察逮捕两名瑞士籍人士一事。

1940年10月1日凌晨12时28分，接到一名身份不明男子的电话报告，称百老汇路与元昌路（Yuenchang Road）交叉口正在发生斗殴，并要求派遣警察前往现场。

巡捕井上（Inoue，编号667）和山口（Yamaguchi，编号861）出警，随后返回警署报告称，斗殴发生在一名瑞士人和一名朝鲜人之间，两人均被日本领事警察带至其杨树浦路（Yangtszepoo Road）213号分所。

本报告人由侦探巡捕泉（Izumi，编号763）陪同，前往上述分所，发现两名被拘留的瑞士籍人士，即乔治·埃米尔·古尔（Georges Emile Guhl），35岁，餐馆老板，住虎园路（Hu Yuan Road）1473号；以及奥托·本克特（Otto Benkert），27岁，住元昌路58号；还有一名被拘留的朝鲜人，名为M. Oka，40岁，商人，住元昌路25号。

本报告人对两名瑞士籍人士进行了讯问，古尔称，在出事之前，他和朋友本克特曾去过元昌路1号的Leaf酒吧，凌晨12点10分左右，他走到

致“C”区副总监。
先生，
奥托·本克特
于1940年10月1日
上午9点45分左右
在其家中接受了
高级侦探督察
别洛申科（Beloshenko）
的问询，他表示
两人均已于1940年
10月1日凌晨4点15分
左右被日本领事
警察释放。他还
表示，他们不打算
就此事向瑞士领事
提出交涉。

Y.O.S.
签名：A. Telfer。
高级侦探主管。
1940年10月1日。

page_data.en:
1/Σ

outside to observe the Korean Oka leaning over his motor
cycle C. . .C. licence No.129, which before entering the
bar he had placed against the pavement, suspecting that
Oka was about to steal some of the fittingshe approached
him and with his open hand pushed him away from the
machine and at the same time warned him to leave it alone.
Oka, then walked away and he re-entered the bar.
About 10 minutes later he again left the bar and
upon emerging onto Yuenshang Road, received a sharp blow
on the left side of his face and observed Oka the person
who had struck the blow standing with two Japanese
marines, he retaliated and his friend Benkert, hearing
the commotion left the bar and joined in the struggle
which only lasted a few minutes, when suddenly the two
P.P.S.s from Hongkew Station arrived on the scene and
had almost settled the matter when the Consular Police
arrived and took both he and his friend to No.215
Yangtsepoo Road.
Japanese Consular Constable M. Nakamoto, who was in
charge of the Sub-Station, but could not speak English
had Oehl's explanation translated to him by D.P.S. Izumi,
and then stated that the statement was not correct
insofar as the Japanese marines had stated that Oehl, had
first attacked Oka. It was then pointed out to him that
both Oehl and Benkert, were Swiss subjects and enjoy
page_data.zh:
1/Σ

室外，看到朝鲜人Oka正俯身在他的摩托车旁，该车牌照号为C...C.129，他在进入酒吧前将车停放在人行道上，因怀疑Oka企图偷窃车上配件，便走近并用张开的手掌将其从车旁推开，同时警告他不要乱动。Oka随即走开，他则重新进入酒吧。
大约10分钟后，他再次离开酒吧，刚走到元昌路（原文为Yuenshang Road，疑为Yuenchang之误）上，脸部左侧就遭到重击，并看到打人者Oka正与两名日本海军陆战队员站在一起，他进行了还击，他的朋友本克特听到骚动后离开酒吧加入争斗，争斗仅持续了几分钟，突然，两名来自虹口警署的巡逻警员（P.P.S.s）赶到现场，几乎已将事态平息，此时领事警察赶到，将他和他的朋友带往杨树浦路215号（注：前文为213号）。
负责该分所的日本领事巡捕中本（Nakamoto，音译）不会说英语，由侦探巡捕泉（Izumi）将厄尔（Oehl，注：此处人名拼写与前文Guhl/Benkert不一致，照实译出）的解释翻译给他听，随后他表示，该陈述不正确，因为日本海军陆战队员称是厄尔首先攻击了Oka。于是向他指出，厄尔和本克特均为瑞士籍人士，享有

page_data.en:
1/3.

extraterritorial rights, therefore it would be better
if they should be handed over to the S.M.P. for
investigation. He then demanded that they produce papers
to prove their nationality whereupon Benkert, produced
his passport and Buhl an identification pass bearing
the Swiss Consular stamp, these were accepted by Constable
Nakamoto, who stated that both men would be detained
until investigations were completed. Further representa-
tions for their release were then made whereupon he
stated that both men had been discourteous by upon
entering the office sitting upon his desk and ended by
emphasizing the fact that they would be detained pending
the conclusion of enquiries. Further negotiations appearing
futile the undersigned and D.P.S. Izumi returned to the
station and reported results to F.S. Crame, on charge
room duty, he in turn informed D.O. "C" and Chief
Inspector Perkins, officer in charge. As a result C.I.
Perkins, dressed and accompanied the undersigned and
D.P.S. Izumi, to No. 213 Yangtsepoo Road, to further
negotiate, but upon arrival 5.15 a.m. was informed that
both the Swiss subjects had been released about one hour
before.

Sen. Det. 1/6.

D. S. 526.

D.D.O. agt.
page_data.zh:
1/3.

治外法权，因此最好将他们移交给上海公共租界工部局警务处（S.M.P.）进行调查。随后他要求出示证明其国籍的文件，本克特出示了护照，布尔（Buhl，注：此处拼写与前文Guhl不一致，照实译出）出示了带有瑞士领事馆印章的身份通行证，这些文件被巡捕中本接受，但他表示在两人都将被拘留直至调查结束。随后又为进一步释放他们进行交涉，他却称两人在进入办公室时坐在他的桌子上，行为无礼，并最后强调，在询问结束前他们将一直被拘留。鉴于进一步谈判似乎徒劳无功，本报告人和侦探巡捕泉返回警署，向值班房务长克莱姆（Crame）报告结果，后者随即通知“C”区总监和主管督察珀金斯（Perkins）。结果，首席督察珀金斯穿好衣服，陪同本报告人和侦探巡捕泉前往杨树浦路213号进行进一步交涉，但于凌晨5点15分到达时获悉，两名瑞士籍人士已在约一小时前被释放。

高级侦探 1/6。

D. S. 526。

代理“C”区副总监。
